summary: Introduction to the ansible-core 2.15 porting guide describing changes from ansible-core 2.14, to be read with the 2.15 changelog.
questions: Where do I start when upgrading to ansible-core 2.15?

answer_card.title: ansible-core 2.14 → 2.15 overview
answer_card.answer_md: The ansible-core **2.15** porting guide lists behaviour changes since **2.14** that may require updates to playbooks, plugins and other content. Read it together with the ansible-core 2.15 changelog.
